rooted_monitor.reason: Oplus places FOD touchable windows as root-level siblings above normal display Input Overlays; native spy-window scan stops at first touched non-spy
rooted_monitor.solution: Own bufferless root-eligible container above FOD, containing only the bridge passive InputMonitor. Dispose receiver then monitor, remove and release owned root.
rooted_monitor.verification: Standalone probe input list index0 and real dispatcher events paired FOD target with raised spy only
rooted_monitor.guard: Only active during valid dash fingerprint sessions with screen on; never pilfers pointers or fabricates authentication

status_notifications.reason: Oplus sends touch-down/up/failure as show() notifications; they are not a new AcquisitionClient request and must not stop the active bridge.
